comparison.objective: Extract a terminal; record places three devices on matching wireless charging locations.
comparison.physical_skill: Lock-tab access and withdrawal versus multi-object pose placement, stand stabilization, and verification of charging indicators.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal exits intact versus all three released devices charge simultaneously for five seconds with the stand held within 5 mm and 5 degrees. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The charging task tests stable functional placement, not mechanical retention release.
